subject: Preflight: BrightWorks QBR — renewal health + exec asks
messages:
From: Elena Soto <esoto@brightworks.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: renewals@brightworks.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep & renewal info request

Hi Marcus / Grace,

Thanks again for the heads-up about the upcoming QBR. Our renewals team asked me to consolidate a quick pre-meeting packet so we can surface any execution blockers and exec-level asks ahead of Wednesday. Can you send over a short risk register and any exec attention items you plan to raise (credits, performance SLAs, outstanding security items)?

A couple of notes from our side:
- We saw increased token spend in May after the embedding rollout; chief question is whether usage normalization is expected in July.
- We're still waiting on the audit timeline for the request for export logs (SOC2 evidence).

If possible, can you share a one-page health snapshot and a recommended MAP (mutual action plan) by EOD Tuesday? I attached our latest usage extract for your reference (attachment: BrightWorks_current_usage.csv).

Appreciate it — looking to keep the QBR focused and avoid surprise escalations.

Best,
Elena
Director, Renewals | BrightWorks
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@brightworks.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep & renewal info request

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the CSV. We're on it.

Quick internal plan (will send the one-pager and MAP to your Drive link tomorrow morning):
1) Health snapshot: Grace will own a short Executive Snapshot covering availability, latency trends, token economics (May spike drivers), and adoption metrics.
2) Risk register & exec asks: I'll consolidate items that require leadership sign-off (credits / SLA credits / escalation support) and propose mitigations/owner for each.
3) Security/compliance ask: Lauren will confirm SOC2 evidence status and ETA for delivery of export logs.

Internal owners assigned here so we all have visibility. Elena — we'll drop the PDF and a one-page MAP to the drive link you referenced by Tue 09:00 PT. If anything changes, we'll flag earlier.

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:53:00 -0700
Subject: BrightWorks — Exec snapshot & preliminary risk register (attached)

Elena / Marcus — attached is a short executive snapshot and the first-pass risk register (attachment: BW-HealthSnapshot-2028Q2.pdf). Highlights:
- Availability: 99.92% for Q2, two brief disruptions on 2028-05-14 (GPU scheduler regression) — engineering root cause fixed 05/15 and a patch deployed.
- Latency: Median DC latency within SLO; 95th percentile spiked during the embedding rollout window (05/03–05/10).
- Cost: May token spend + embedding indexing accounted for the spend delta; preliminary recommendation to apply temporary per-call batching and prefix cache to reduce per-token billable costs by ~18% without UX regression.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 artifact collection is in progress; Lauren will share timeline.

Preliminary exec asks (for your review):
- Request 10% credit for May overage while we implement the suggested batching + cache mitigation (Owner: Marcus).
- Approval to prioritize export-log delivery (ETA: Jul 9) and provide a dated commitment to BrightWorks legal (Owner: Lauren).
- Proposed pilot of a dedicated inference pool for a single high-volume endpoint to stabilize tail latency (Owner: Jordan).

We're attaching the MAP (BrightWorks-MAP-v2.docx) with owners and dates. Please flag anything you want escalated to Redwood execs prior to the QBR.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
(attachment: BW-HealthSnapshot-2028Q2.pdf, BrightWorks-MAP-v2.docx)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: CEO Execs <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BrightWorks — pre-QBR packet + proposed exec asks (for sign-off)

Folks — forwarding the BrightWorks snapshot and our proposed asks. TL;DR: customer requests a May overage credit (10%) tied to increased cost from an embedding rollout; we propose a mitigation plan with batching/cache to materially reduce unit costs, delivery of SOC2 export artifacts on Jul 9, and a pilot dedicated pool to address tail latency.

Decision points for execs before the QBR on Thu:
- Authorize up to a 10% goodwill credit for May overage (no precedent beyond this promotion without legal approval).
- Approve prioritization of the export-log workstream and a dated commitment to the customer.
- Sanction trial of a temporary dedicated pool (estimated incremental cost $X/day) for a one-week stabilization window.

Forwarding original thread below for context. If you want a one-page memo, I can distill for Wed AM.

— Jordan

Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightWorks — pre-QBR packet + proposed exec asks (SOC2 ETA and final prep)

Team / Elena — quick updates ahead of the QBR: 
- SOC2/export logs: Legal & engineering synced this morning; commit to BrightWorks: we will deliver the requested export logs by Jul 9 (internal tracker updated).
- Credit ask: recommend we offer a 7–10% goodwill credit contingent on BrightWorks trialing our batching/cache mitigation for 30 days. Financial modeling attached in the Drive link.
- Dedicated pool pilot: engineering confirmed we can provision for a 7-day window with rollback. Jordan, please confirm endpoint and projected incremental cost so I can clear finance.

I'll prepare a one-page exec memo summarizing the three asks and the recommended positions (credit range, SOC2 ETA, pilot terms) — will circulate by 4pm PT for final sign-off.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@brightworks.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final pre-QBR checklist — BrightWorks

Elena / everyone — thanks for the quick turnaround. Final checklist before Thursday's QBR: 
- Grace: one-page health snapshot (done, attached in Drive).
- Lauren: one-page exec memo + finance sign-off on credit range (due by 4pm PT) — noted.
- Jordan: confirm dedicated-pool endpoint and cost estimate (by 2pm PT).
- Marcus: I'll lead the MAP walkthrough and own escalation narrative if execs ask for precedent.

Elena — appreciate your flexibility on the credit range. We'll come prepared with the snapshot, MAP, and an agreed set of asks so the QBR can focus on outcomes. See you Thu at 11:00 PT.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(attachments referenced: BW-HealthSnapshot-2028Q2.pdf, BrightWorks-MAP-v2.docx)
